title: chromamancer target mapping v2
description: Per-target shim → native key map and optional apply_quick / apply_nix defaults. File: targets/<target_id>/mapping.jsonc

shim_to_native.description: Semantic shim (see specs/shim-colors.md) → native config key path(s). Use a string for one target field, or a non-empty array when one shim fans out to multiple native keys (e.g. Albert).

apply_quick.description: Optional defaults for chromamancer apply-quick (paths, flags).

apply_nix.description: Optional defaults for chromamancer apply-nix (e.g. themes_dir, theme_file_template).
